description: Header file defining the MasqueEncapsulatedClientSession class, which manages a QUIC client session encapsulated within MASQUE, supporting IP and packet processing, connection management, and encapsulation capsules.

classes.name: MasqueEncapsulatedClientSession
classes.description: A class representing a QUIC client session encapsulated within MASQUE, supporting IP and packet processing, connection management, and capsule handling.

methods.name: MasqueEncapsulatedClientSession
methods.description: Constructor initializing the session with configuration, versions, connection, server ID, crypto config, push promise index, and masque client session.

methods.name: ProcessPacket
methods.description: Processes an encapsulated packet received from the server.

methods.name: CloseConnection
methods.description: Closes the session with a specified error code, details, and close behavior.

methods.name: CloseIpSession
methods.description: Closes the IP session with provided details.

methods.name: OnConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles the event of connection closure.
